issues.title: The original 90-second clear probe could stop with live structures
issues.detail: Seed 7 reached the wall-clock guard at loop 1784 with two enemy structures remaining while all dispatched push commands were successful.
issues.resolution: The compressed clear probe wall-clock budget is now 120 seconds. Seed 7 was rerun and reached all_objectives_success at loop 1930 with zero remaining structures.

issues.title: Clear-mode target allocation needed hostile-case regression coverage
issues.detail: A push unit can die after a target assignment and a destroyed structure can leave a stale target id in the controller mapping.
issues.resolution: Focused synthetic scenarios cover dead push units, stale target reallocation, infection/day cleanup, building reinforcement pressure, and wall-clock exhaustion. All five cases pass without command failures.
